name: a plain async main
a sync main
source: export function main(a: string, b?: number) { return a }

name: imports, top-level code and the body are dropped
a local alias to Date is kept for hydration (WR-V3)
an alias without a semicolon ends at the line break
source:
type When = Date
export async function main(at: When) {}

name: a union alias over several lines
an exported generic alias with an object type
source:
export type Box<T = string> = { value: T; at: Date }
export async function main(b: Box) {}
keep: export type Box<T = string> = { value: T; at: Date }

name: an interface with a generic bound
source:
export interface Row<T extends {a: 1}> { a: T }
export function main(r: Row<{a: 1}>) {}
keep: export interface Row<T extends {a: 1}> { a: T }

name: defaults that are literals, globals or earlier parameters
source: export async function main(a = 1, b = "x", c = [1, {k: true}], d = new Date(0), e = a + 1, f = Math.PI, g = `t${a}`) {}
params: a = 1, b = "x", c = [1, {k: true}], d = new Date(0), e = a + 1, f = Math.PI, g = `t${a}`

name: generic annotations with commas and a default after >=
source: export async function main(m: Map<string, Array<number>>, n: Array<number>= [], cb?: (x: number) => void) {}
params: m: Map<string, Array<number>>, n: Array<number>= [], cb?: (x: number) => void

name: a destructured parameter (anon1, WR-7)
source: export async function main({ a, b }: { a: string; b: number }) {}
params: { a, b }: { a: string; b: number }

name: comments and strings that look like code
a function expression named main is not the entrypoint
source:
const f = function main(x) {};
export async function main(y: number) {}

name: type and interface used as names are not declarations
a hashbang and division
an empty parameter list
source: export async function main() { return 1 }

name: an arrow-function main
source: export const main = async (x: number) => x;

name: no main
source: export async function run(x: number) {}

name: a main exported through an export list
source:
function main(x) {}
export { main };

name: a default-exported main
source: export default async function main(x) {}

name: a generator main
source: export function* main(x) {}

name: a generic main
source: export async function main<T>(x: T) {}

name: overloads
source:
export function main(x: string): void;
export function main(x: any) {}

name: a preprocessor
source:
export async function preprocessor(e: object) { return e }
export async function main(x: number) {}

name: a default that names a dropped binding is kept, and never runs
source:
const LIMIT = 10;
export async function main(limit = LIMIT) {}

name: a parameter named like the stub's helpers is out of their scope
source: export async function main(__wlReplay: number) {}

name: an unterminated string
source: export async function main(x = "oops) {}

name: an unterminated template
source: export async function main(x = `oops) {}

name: an unterminated comment
source: /* export async function main(x) {}

name: unbalanced brackets
source: export async function main(x) { if (x) {

name: an alias after a line that ends in >
an interface after a line that ends in >
code on the line after an alias is not part of it
a type argument list does not continue an alias on the next line
defaults inside a pattern may use literals and earlier names
source: export async function main({ a = 1, b = a, c: { d = [true] } = {} }: T) {}

name: a default inside a pattern is kept, and never runs
source:
const LIMIT = 3;
export async function main({ a = LIMIT }: { a?: number }) {}

name: a default that calls through globalThis is kept, and never runs
source: export async function main(x = globalThis.fetch("http://private.invalid/")) {}

name: a default that reads process is kept, and never runs
source: export async function main(x = process.env.X) {}

name: a default that spawns through Bun is kept, and never runs
source: export async function main(x = Bun.spawnSync(["id"])) {}

name: the annotation flags of the leading block are kept (WR-31)
a flag after the leading block is not an annotation
an indented flag ends the leading block
source:
//nodejs
export async function main(n: number) {}

name: a ternary default that calls fetch is kept, and never runs
source: export async function main(x = (true ? fetch : null)("https://synthetic.invalid", {method: "POST"})) { return x }

name: a ternary default that names a dropped binding is kept, and never runs
source: const LIMIT = 5; export async function main(x = true ? LIMIT : 0) { return x }

name: a parameter named Array
source: export async function main(Array: string) { return Array }

name: a destructured binding named Array
source: export async function main({ Array }: { Array: string }) { return Array }

name: main exported under its name from another local
a main declared and never exported
source:
function main(x) {}
export { other };

name: a main re-exported from another module
source:
function main(x) {}
export { main } from "./elsewhere";
